_comment: Canonical catalog for the 10 agentic-edge benchmark tasks. Single source of truth for display name + description; consumed by scripts/report.py (and available to the harness/decks). n = stable test number.

file_ops.name: File operations
file_ops.desc: The agent reads a notes file from disk, summarizes it, and writes a new file back — exercises the file read/write tools plus a short LLM summary.

spec_rag.name: Spec Q&A (RAG)
spec_rag.desc: Answers a hardware question about the i.MX 95 Neutron NPU, grounded in the datasheet corpus via retrieval.

doc_brief.name: Doc brief (long-context)
doc_brief.desc: Generates a one-page product brief for the i.MX 95 from the datasheets — a longer retrieval context and a longer generation (prefill-heavier).

email.name: Email drafting
email.desc: Drafts a clear, friendly intro email about the i.MX 95 for an edge-AI product, with the specifics grounded in the datasheets.

web_summarize.name: Web search + summarize
web_summarize.desc: Runs a live web search for the i.MX 95 and summarizes the results in a few sentences — network I/O followed by a short generation.

transcribe.name: Audio transcription (ASR)
transcribe.desc: Transcribes a short audio clip with Whisper — CPU/accelerator audio compute, no LLM generation.

meeting_summarize.name: Meeting summary
meeting_summarize.desc: Transcribes a recording with Whisper and then summarizes it with the LLM — a two-stage ASR→LLM pipeline.

ocr.name: Image OCR
ocr.desc: Extracts text from a datasheet-page image with Tesseract — a CPU task where the GPU/NPU is idle (~3%).

run_script.name: Sandboxed script
run_script.desc: Executes a sandboxed helper script via the agent's run-script tool and returns its output.

multi_tool_chain.name: Multi-tool chain
multi_tool_chain.desc: A multi-step agent task: note the key specs, write them to a file, then draft a short email — tests whether the model actually invokes tools in sequence vs. narrating the steps.
